### Implementation Summary
- **`bridge.py`**: Discovers active nonce dynamically from `SWARM_BRIDGE_NONCE` or `SWARM_NONCE_FILE` (`/dev/shm/vqa-cu/swarm/nonce.txt`), skips dotfiles/`.tmp`, rejects non-matching or mismatched-nonce files to `SWARM_REJECTED` (`INVALID_NAME` / `NONCE_MISMATCH` logged to `rejected.jsonl`), executes valid scripts sorted by `<seq>` with `stdout`/`stderr` capture, unlinks consumed `.py`, and atomically writes `<nonce>__<seq>__<event_id>.json` receipts to `SWARM_OUTBOX`.
- **`broker.py`**: Generates per-run 16-hex nonce, emits `claim` leases (`lease_epoch=1`, default `ttl_ms=3600000` [TARGET]), captures initial `frame_0` and subsequent `frame_<N>` PNG + JSON + atomic `latest.json` (`--vision-mode live|mock`), computes connected-block pixel diffs (`compute_changed_regions`) when needed, ingests bounded agent FIFOs (`MAX_FIFO=8`) plus `director-agent` control ops (`stop`, `resume`, `reconcile`, `park`, `checkpoint`) at turn boundaries, and enforces `STATE_VERIFIED`, `JOB_ERROR`, `OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN`, `VERIFIED`, `VERIFIED_WITH_SPILL`, `NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE`, `INPUT_UNCERTAIN`, `STALE_FRAME` (`3`-drop park), `FRAME_EVICTED`, `FOOTPRINT_MISSING`, `NO_LEASE`, `LEASE_EXPIRED`, `CLAIM_REFUSED`, `TURN_TIMEOUT` (`2`-streak park), `QUEUE_FULL`, `DUPLICATE_EVENT`, and `PASS`.
